originalTitle: Ethiopia's Virgin Mary festival in Tigray cancelled over drone strike fears
title: Sad News: A Big Party in Ethiopia is Postponed for Safety!
content:
Hello from Your Africa Kid Reporter!

Hi everyone! It's your kid reporter, here to tell you some news from our amazing continent, Africa. Today, we're talking about a special country called Ethiopia. It's a land full of history, wonderful people, and beautiful places. Sometimes, news can be a little bit sad, but it's important to learn about what's happening. Today, we have some news about a very big and joyful party that was going to happen there.

Sad News for a Big Party!

Imagine you are getting ready for a super fun party. You have your best clothes picked out, you're excited to see your friends, and you know there will be delicious food and happy music! Well, in Ethiopia, many people were getting ready for a party just like that. It's called the Virgin Mary festival. It's a very special celebration that many, many women and their families love to attend. But, we have some sad news. This big party, this wonderful festival, has been put on hold. It means it won't happen right now, even though everyone was looking forward to it. It's like when your picnic is cancelled because it starts to rain. It makes people feel a little disappointed, doesn't it?

What is This Special Party About?

The Virgin Mary festival is a really important day for many people in Ethiopia. It's a religious celebration, which means it's a day when people show their love and respect for someone very special to their faith, called the Virgin Mary. People gather together to pray, to sing beautiful songs, and to share happy times. Did you know? Festivals in Africa are often full of bright colours! People wear their very best clothes, which can be made from colourful fabrics with amazing patterns. Imagine a rainbow of happy people all in one place!

Imagine the Fun!

At this festival, people would have done so many fun things! They would have sung songs together, with everyone's voices joining to make beautiful music. They would have danced, moving their bodies to happy rhythms. Imagine their feet tapping and their hands clapping! There would also be lots of yummy food! Special dishes are made just for festivals, and families share meals together. It's a time to laugh, to tell stories, and to feel close to each other. Many women travel from far away just to be a part of this special day.

Where is Tigray, Ethiopia?

This festival was going to happen in a part of Ethiopia called Tigray. Ethiopia is a big country in East Africa. If you look at a map of Africa, you would find Ethiopia on the eastern side, near countries like Kenya and Somalia. It's a land with tall mountains, ancient churches carved into rocks, and a very long history. Did you know? Ethiopia is famous for being the birthplace of coffee! So, if your grown-ups drink coffee, they can thank Ethiopia for that delicious drink!

Why Was the Party Cancelled?

Now, for the important part: why was this happy festival put on hold? The grown-ups decided it was not safe enough right now. They were worried about something called 'drone strikes.' That sounds a bit serious, doesn't it? Let's talk about what a 'drone' is in a simple way.

What is a Drone?

Imagine a remote-control toy plane, but much bigger and much smarter. That's a bit like a drone! Drones are flying machines. Sometimes, people use drones for fun things, like taking cool pictures from high in the sky, or even delivering small packages. They fly without a person inside them. But sometimes, grown-ups also use drones for other reasons, and they can make loud noises or cause problems. When people are gathered in a big crowd, like at a festival, and there's a worry about these flying machines causing trouble, it means it might not be safe for everyone to be there. The grown-ups who look after the people want to make sure everyone is safe and sound. So, they made the difficult decision to cancel the festival this time. They didn't want anyone to get hurt or to feel scared.

Keeping Everyone Safe

It's like when your parents tell you not to run too fast near the road, or when your teacher says to be careful on the playground. They do it because they want to keep you safe. The grown-ups in Tigray are doing the same thing for all the people who wanted to celebrate the festival. They know that many people will be sad and disappointed. But keeping people safe is the most important thing. Safety always comes first, even before big parties. Did you know? There are many different types of festivals all over Africa! Some celebrate harvests, some celebrate new seasons, and some celebrate important history. They are all about bringing people together!

Why Are Festivals Important?

Festivals are very special because they bring communities together. They help people remember their history and traditions. They give everyone a chance to meet family and friends they haven't seen in a while. They also bring joy and happiness! When a festival is cancelled, it means people miss out on these important times for connection and celebration.

Hoping for Happier Times

So, for now, the Virgin Mary festival in Tigray will not happen. But people will remember the fun they usually have and hope that next year, they can all gather again, safe and sound, to celebrate with all their hearts. We hope that soon, everyone in Tigray can feel peaceful and happy all the time. We will keep our fingers crossed for a wonderful festival next time!

Let's Learn About Africa!

Africa is a continent with so many amazing stories and cultures. There are 54 different countries, each with its own special traditions. Learning about them helps us understand the big, wide world we live in. We hope to bring you more news from our amazing continent soon!
summary: A big and joyful Virgin Mary festival in Tigray, Ethiopia, has been cancelled because grown-ups were worried about people's safety due to fears about flying machines called drones.
whyMatters: This matters because a special party that many people love and look forward to has been put on hold, making people sad, but it's important to keep everyone safe.

originalTitle: Russian double-tap drone strike kills 15 in Ukrainian mall, officials say
title: Sad News from Far Away, Wishing for Peace for Everyone
content:
Hello, My Wonderful Friends from Africa!

Hello everyone! It’s your friend here, your kid-friendly news reporter, bringing you important news from around our big, beautiful world. Today, I have a story that makes our hearts a little bit heavy, but it also reminds us how important it is to be kind and wish for peace everywhere. We are going to talk about something sad that happened very far away, in a country called Ukraine. Even though it's far, we care about all the children and families there.

A Sad Day in a Shopping Place

Imagine going to a big, fun place with your family, maybe to buy new clothes, or some yummy treats, or even just to play. This kind of place is called a shopping mall. It's usually full of smiles and laughter. But in Ukraine, in a city called Kremenchuk, a very sad thing happened in a shopping mall. Something big and loud flew from the sky and made a very scary noise, like a giant bang. It hit the shopping mall, and it caused a lot of damage.

What is a Shopping Mall?

Let's think about what a shopping mall is. It’s like a super big market, but inside a huge building! There are many shops where grown-ups buy things like food, clothes, and toys. There are often places to eat tasty food and sometimes even fun places to play games. Malls are usually happy places where families spend time together, laughing and making memories. So, when something bad happens in a place like that, it makes everyone feel very, very sad.

Many People Got Hurt

When the loud bang happened at the shopping mall, many people were inside. Some grown-ups and even some children got hurt. Doctors and nurses had to rush to help everyone who was injured. It was a very busy and sad time for the helpers. More than one hundred people needed help because they got hurt. And what makes us even sadder is that some grown-ups sadly lost their lives that day. This means they are no longer with their families, and that is a very, very hard thing for everyone.

Did You Know?

Did you know that doctors and nurses are like superheroes? They work very hard to make sick or hurt people feel better. They are always ready to help when sad things happen, no matter where in the world it is.

Helpers Are There

When something bad happens, it’s not just the doctors and nurses who help. Many other kind people come to help too. Firefighters, police officers, and even regular people who live nearby come to help find people, take them to safe places, and make sure they get what they need. They bring comfort and care when it is needed most. It shows us that even when bad things happen, there are always good people ready to help.

Wishing for Peace for Everyone

News like this reminds us that sometimes grown-ups fight in different parts of the world. This fighting is called a war. War is a very sad thing because it can hurt innocent people and damage happy places like shopping malls. We wish for the fighting to stop so that all children and families can be safe and happy again. Every child, everywhere, deserves to grow up in a peaceful world, where they can play and learn without fear.

Did You Know?

Did you know that Ukraine is a country very, very far away from Africa? If you were to fly in an aeroplane, it would take many, many hours to get there! But even though it's far, we are all part of the same big world, and we care about each other.

Sending Our Love from Africa

Even though we are here in Africa, we can send our good thoughts and wishes to the children and families in Ukraine. We hope that they can heal from their injuries and that their hearts can feel better soon. We hope that peace will come to their country, and to all countries where people are fighting. Remember to always be kind to your friends and family, and to everyone you meet. Kindness helps to make the world a happier and safer place for all.

Did You Know?

Did you know that when children are safe and happy, they can learn and play and dream big dreams? That's why wishing for peace is so important, because it helps children everywhere have a bright future. Let’s all keep hoping for a world full of peace, smiles, and kindness. That’s all for today’s news, my friends. See you next time!
summary: A sad event occurred in a shopping mall in Ukraine where many people, including children, were hurt, reminding us all to wish for peace and kindness in the world.
whyMatters: This is important because it shows us that even far away, people can get hurt when there is fighting. It teaches us to care for others, wish for peace, and remember that helpers are always there to make things better.
